subject: Re: Kickoff: weight-space accuracy prediction (dnn-predict-accuracy)
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing plan: Yara owns the predictor modeling, Leilani takes the Evalline integration, Katya is on training pipelines. Compute is modest — the Zoo models are tiny, so titan-a100 best-effort covers us.

One addition to scope we agreed in eng review: to make the predictor useful beyond the Zoo architecture, we are scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe built from scratch — Katya leads it at 50% starting mid-April, with a design doc due April 24. Nothing in-house exists for this today, so we're budgeting roughly six engineer-weeks to stand up the recipe end to end (teacher selection, temperature schedules, checkpoint capture at the same 9-epoch grid we used for the Zoo).

That puts v1 predictor risk mostly on data breadth, not compute. More at Thursday's sync.

Ivo
